notes: A discovered PHP branch is not enabled for packaging automatically until CI is green.
Launchpad builds should be driven by distro-specific source uploads and reviewed PRs.

base_php_version is the suite's distro-native PHP (the version in the Ubuntu archive before any third-party PPA): noble (24.04) -> 8.3, resolute (26.04) -> 8.5. Its php<ver>-pinba is the 'base' package, installable on a clean OS with no ondrej/php. Informational constant, kept by update-packaging-matrix.php (which only rewrites php_versions); the build-base-deb CI job builds and load-tests it in a pristine ubuntu container.

php_versions per suite must be the PHP versions actually installable on the Launchpad build farm for that suite. noble (24.04) gets 8.2-8.5 via the ondrej/php PPA dependency; resolute (26.04) gets only 8.5 because the 26.04 archive ships only php8.5 and ondrej/php has no resolute series.
The publish workflow regenerates debian/control Build-Depends per suite from these php_versions, so each suite only build-depends on the php<ver>-dev it can install.
